# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (0400486024DEC000) ---
# Opt-in fast paths from perf/oot-fast-draw, measured on Donkey Kong Bananza only. Enable one at a
# time and compare FPS (EDEN_NX2_GPU_PROFILE=1 logs GPU thread time per zone). Remove any that
# cause missing geometry, flicker or pop-in.
# Reuse bindings of unchanged draws (1), or also keep them across constant/index buffer changes (2).
#EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW=1
# Skip repeated vertex buffer lookups and upload scans of unchanged ranges.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_SKIP=1
# Only invalidate texture/query/shader cache pages that hold something.
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_INVALIDATE=1
# Skip redundant dynamic state updates.
#EDEN_NX2_DYNAMIC_SKIP=1
# Record large render passes on this many threads (2-8); 4 suits a 6-core CPU.
#EDEN_NX2_PARALLEL_RECORD=4
